name: TimedSignalMapAPI

functions.name: CancelAllSignals
documentation: Cancels all scheduled signals.

functions.name: CancelSignal
documentation: Cancels the scheduled signal for the specified key, if one exists.

arguments.name: key
documentation: Key to cancel. No effect if the key is not scheduled.

functions.name: GetNextSignal
documentation: Returns the next key due to signal along with its scheduled time.

returns.name: key
documentation: The key that has been scheduled.

returns.name: time
documentation: Absolute time, on the same clock as GetTime(), at which the key is scheduled to signal.

functions.name: GetSignalCount
documentation: Returns the number of keys currently scheduled to signal.

returns.name: count
documentation: Count of scheduled keys.

functions.name: GetSignalTime
documentation: Returns the absolute time at which the specified key is scheduled to signal.

arguments.name: key
documentation: Key to query.

returns.name: time
documentation: Absolute time the key will signal; nil if not scheduled.

functions.name: HasSignal
documentation: Returns whether the specified key is currently scheduled to signal.

arguments.name: key
documentation: Key to test.

returns.name: hasSignal
documentation: True if the key is scheduled to signal.

functions.name: SignalAfter
documentation: Schedules the specified key to signal after a delay from the current time, replacing any existing schedule for that key.

arguments.name: key
documentation: Key to signal. Re-scheduling an existing key replaces its time.

arguments.name: secondsFromNow
documentation: Delay in seconds from now, converted to an absolute time when scheduled.

functions.name: SignalAt
documentation: Schedules the specified key to signal at an absolute time, replacing any existing schedule for that key.

arguments.name: key
documentation: Key to signal. Re-scheduling an existing key replaces its time.

arguments.name: time
documentation: Absolute time at which to signal, on the same clock as GetTime().
An object that manages a collection of integer keys, each scheduled to signal at a specific time.
When a key's time arrives it is removed from the map and passed to the map's callback, letting you track many keyed deadlines through a single callback rather than scheduling each one individually.
